公司簡介
CORPORATE PROFILE


華潤水泥控股有限公司於二零零三年三月十三日根據開曼群島公司法在開曼群島註冊成立為一
家獲豁免的有限公司，並為華潤集團所有水泥及混凝土業務的控股公司。

本公司曾於二零零三年七月二十九日以介紹形式在香港聯合交易所有限公司主板上市。於二零
零六年，本公司被華潤（集團）有限公司私有化成為順創投資有限公司（現稱華潤集團（水泥）有限
公司）的全資附屬公司，並於二零零六年七月二十六日撤銷其股份在聯交所的上市地位。

本公司於二零零九年十月六日以全球發售形式重新於聯交所主板上市。於本報告日期，本公司
已發行股份總數為6,982,937,817股，其中華潤集團持有約68.72%的本公司已發行股份。

China Resources Cement Holdings Limited was incorporated on 13 March 2003 in the Cayman Islands as an
exempted company with limited liability under the Companies Law of the Cayman Islands and is the holding
company of all the cement and concrete operations of China Resources Group.


The Company was listed on the main board of The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited on 29 July 2003 by way
of introduction. In 2006, the Company was privatized as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Smooth Concept Investments
Limited (currently known as CRH (Cement) Limited) by China Resources (Holdings) Company Limited and the listing
of the Company’s shares on the Stock Exchange was withdrawn on 26 July 2006.


The Company was re-listed on the main board of the Stock Exchange on 6 October 2009 by way of a global offering.
As at the date of this report, the total number of issued shares of the Company was 6,982,937,817 shares, of which
China Resources Group is holding approximately 68.72% of the issued shares of the Company.

本集團對財務管理採取穩健審慎的財政政策，          The Group adopts robust and prudent treasury policies in financial
資金管理、融資及投資活動均由本公司高級管          management. Treasury management, financing and investment activities
理層管理及監督，且本集團的資金活動均集中          are all managed and monitored by the senior management of the
管理。本集團定期監察目前及預期的流動資金          Company, and all treasury activities of the Group are centralized. The
需求及銀行貸款協議的合規情況，確保其維持          Group regularly monitors its current and expected liquidity needs as
足夠現金儲備及保持資金的靈活性，以滿足本          well as compliance with bank loan agreements in order to maintain its
集團短期及長期的流動資金需求。               sufficient cash reserves and flexibility in funding for meeting the Group’s
                              short-term and long-term liquidity needs.

然而，管理層定期監察相關外幣風險，並將考          hedging policy in respect of foreign currency exposure. However, the

主席及總裁的角色及職能                                       ROLES AND FUNCTIONS OF CHAIRMAN AND
                                                  CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER

主席                                                Chairman

      團會考慮市場參與者於計量日對資產                                  Group takes into account the characteristics of the asset or liability

     此外，就財務呈報而言，公平價值計量           In addition, for financial reporting purposes, fair value
     根據公平價值計量的輸入數據可觀察            measurements are categorized into Level 1, 2 or 3 based on the
     程度及公平價值計量的輸入數據對其            degree to which the inputs to the fair value measurements are

          ；

         或間接觀察的輸入數據；及                   liability, either directly or indirectly; and

     綜合基準                        Basis of consolidation


     綜合財務報表將本公司及其附屬公司            The consolidated financial statements incorporate the financial
     與其所控制實體的財務報表綜合入賬。           statements of the Company and entities controlled by the
     當本公司出現以下情況時則視為取得            Company and its subsidiaries. Control is achieved when the
     控制權：                        Company:


     •   可對被投資公司行使權力；            •      has power over the investee;


     •   就來自參與被投資公司的可變           •      is exposed, or has rights, to variable returns from its
         回報中承受風險或享有權利；及                 involvement with the investee; and


     •   有能力行使權力以影響其回報。          •      has the ability to use its power to affect its returns.


     倘事實及情況顯示以上所列三種控制            The Group reassesses whether or not it controls an investee if facts

     備。就首次確認以來信貸風險大幅增加           a significant increase in credit risk since initial recognition, a loss

     增加。於作出該評估時，本集團將於報           recognition. When making the assessment, the Group compares

     史及前瞻性資料）。                   undue cost or effort, including historical and forward-looking

  現 金 產 生 單 位 組。分 配 至 水 泥 及 混 凝       and concrete operating segment. The carrying amounts of

  水泥及混凝土現金產生單位組的可收                    The recoverable amounts of the groups of CGUs of cement and
  回金額按使用價值基準釐定，並根據管                   concrete operations have been determined based on the value
  理層批准的財務預算預測的現金流量                    in use calculation. That calculation uses cash flow projections
  分別按五年期間5%（二零二零年：5%）                 based on financial budgets approved by management covering
  的增長率及13%（二零二零年：13%）的                a five-year period with a growth rate of 5% (2020: 5%) and a

  預測釐定，不超過有關行業的平均長期                   the industry growth forecasts and does not exceed the average
  增長率。五年期後的現金流量採用零增                   long-term growth rate for the relevant industry. The cash flows
  長率估算。計算使用價值的主要假設乃                   beyond the five year period are extrapolated using zero growth
  預算毛利率，該毛利率按單位的過往表                   rate. The key assumption for the value in use calculation is the
  現及管理層對市場發展的預期而釐定。                   budgeted gross margin, which is determined based on the unit’s
